description: The US federal budget month by month from the Monthly Treasury Statement (since 2015): receipts, outlays and the deficit for this fiscal year and the last, and the fiscal year to date against the same months a year earlier, for the latest statement or any month's.

statement.description: The month of the Monthly Treasury Statement to read (it covers its fiscal year to that month). Default the latest.

name: federal_budget

outputSchema.description: rows are months, oldest first, with receipts, outlays and the deficit in US dollars.

title: Federal budget (Monthly Treasury Statement)
